Measured as the reference file of a Gemma 4 E2B finetune-to-.litertlm conversion (hold r2a 2026-10-20 01:37–02:03 JST; MTP on). Harness = a benchmark script; one process per run, litert_lm_advanced_main --benchmark with 1024 prefill / 256 decode tokens, max_num_tokens 2048, speculative decoding off (the v0.18.0 CLI's default); cells = the median of the 2 counted runs (warm: the hold's first process wrote the ML Drift program / weight caches and is not counted; the GPU counting rule = no GPU-side ceiling: Mali cooling 0 and thermal status 0 in every sample of both runs); init = Init Total; peak = the process VmHWM (kB x 1,024 / 10^6 MB, per run in metrics); GPU = LiteRT's OpenCL backend (Mali-G715) at the bundle's fp16 activations. The text graph's four signatures run whole on LITERT_CL; the embedder (2 of 8 nodes) and the per-layer embedder (1 of 42 nodes) run on XNNPACK and the CPU kernels, so full_delegation is false and the per-subgraph counts are the evidence lines. Not entered: the CPU runs of the same holds (every run cold in its hold and under a lowered CPU clock: no clean run), the Mac M4 Max CPU benchmark of run r1 (one run), the Galaxy S26 NPU runs of the Hub's sm8850 / sm8750 files (a self-built runtime whose commit is not established, with QAIRT 2.50 QNN libraries in place of the build's 2.47 set), and every unpublished form exported along the way.
